derivation_rationale.source_spine: EF scale degrees of damage (Texas Tech WSEC 2006 Rev 2; NOAA SPC) for FR12, MBS and LRB, priced through the FEMA Hazus damage states (Hazus 7.0 Hurricane TM §8.1.4.3 and Tables 5-44, 5-74, 5-78).
derivation_rationale.adopted_form: expected cost over ordered degrees of damage, each lognormal in gust (median = expected speed, beta from the bounds read as a 90% range); tabulated every 1 mph; straight-line onset 96 mph
derivation_rationale.why_not_hurricane_curves: Separate evidence per hazard (owner choice, D-CWRE-03); hurricane-curve reuse is the documented alternative.
derivation_rationale.parameter_tier_mix: Speeds T3 (expert elicitation); cost assignment, spread reading, onset and the straight-line transfer T4; range T2.
derivation_rationale.nri_check: Straight-line yearly loss 13-35x NRI with the onset (370-500x without); tornado 0.11-0.26x NRI (hazard-side geometry).
